Companion Animal Travel Desk Help for Companion Animal Travelers

This article is for travelers who are planning a trip with a pet on Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps you prepare calmly, with clear guidance before departure and steady support along the way.

Start by checking the documents and carrier needs for your animal before you travel. A soft, secure carrier is usually best for comfort and safety, and it should give your pet room to settle without being loose. If your trip includes airport services, follow the signs and ask staff where companion animal spaces are located so you can move through the terminal with less stress.

When you arrive, keep your pet close and watch for relief and rest areas. <<FACT F021>> Use the lounge only as directed by staff, and bring what your pet needs for a calm stop. If you are traveling through a connection point, ask for the nearest relief area before boarding so you can plan ahead with less rushing.

For kennel or quarantine support, follow the instructions given by the airline and airport team. <<FACT F028>> If your pet needs extra handling, speak with the desk early so the right arrangements can be reviewed before departure. Clear notice helps the senior coordinator and service team keep the process smooth for everyone.

Before boarding, make sure your pet is comfortable, secure, and ready for the next step. <<FACT F013>> If anything changes during travel, the Companion Animal Travel Desk can help you adjust the plan and keep your companion supported.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through Aurelia Skyways customer support.
